import numpy as np

def rlhf_reward(output, reference, reward_model, beta=0.1):
    r = reward_model(output)
    output_probs = np.exp(output) / np.sum(np.exp(output))
    reference_probs = np.exp(reference) / np.sum(np.exp(reference))
    kl = np.sum(output_probs * np.log(output_probs / (reference_probs + 1e-10) + 1e-10))
    final_reward = r - beta * kl
    return final_reward
